targets.rawSql:
SELECT
	date_bin('$__interval', thrs_data.timestamp) AS time,
	concat('[', coalesce(metadata.yard_tag, ''), '] ', thrs_data.technical_name) AS device,
	AVG(temperature__value) AS "temperature"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures AS thrs_data
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT mqtt_topic, yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata WHERE mqtt_topic LIKE 'marpower/500000-thrs/%'
) AS metadata ON thrs_data.topic = metadata.mqtt_topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(thrs_data.timestamp)
  AND ',' || '${section:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || split_part(thrs_data.topic, '/', 3) || ',%'
  AND ',' || '${device:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || thrs_data.technical_name || ',%'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2, 1 ASC
